description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Door Panel for the Passenger Side.
Has Attachment Clip Slots Pre-Cut into the Back of the Panel.
Has all Required Openings Pre-Cut to Accept the Door Bezels, Door Pulls, Regulator Handles and Limit Straps.
Made from Black Vinyl over Hardboard.
Note: Door Panel has minor damage on top point
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – RH Door Panel – Black
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1980 – 1984 All Models
